europe_now.title: Mass Protests Across France
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of thousands of individuals participated in demonstrations across France during a high-risk weekend of unrest. The interior ministry reported that roughly 320,000 protesters turned out as authorities deployed a significant security response.

top_stories.title: Humanitarian Evacuation from Occupied Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Civilians from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky completed an evacuation operation and arrived in Ukraine. The newly arrived evacuees were able to reunite with their families after enduring prolonged isolation.

top_stories.title: G20 Discussions Over Russia
top_stories.summary: Diplomatic disagreements emerged among G20 ministers regarding the presence of Russia. European officials warned that accommodating Russian leadership risks normalizing ongoing war crimes.
